scope.entry_summary: After the first 5 to 15 minutes, identify a support level on the 5-minute chart using price action and moving averages such as the 13 EMA or, if that fails, the 200 EMA. Enter when price comes down into that support area and bounces.
scope.exit_summary: Take profit quickly at the next resistance / after the bounce move; the speaker repeatedly frames the management as getting in and out fast and selling into the move rather than holding all day.
scope.name: support_to_resistance_scalp

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: time your entries once you have allowed the first 5 to 15 minutes to pass
entry_sequence.action: Wait for the first 5 to 15 minutes after market open to pass before timing entries.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker says this waiting period helps establish support.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: look at this indicator the 13 EMA in this example on the 5 minute chart
entry_sequence.action: Use the 5-minute chart and identify support with the 13 EMA; if that support fails, use deeper support such as the 200 EMA.
entry_sequence.rationale: The setup is built around support on the 5-minute chart using moving averages.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: what you want to do is look and learn to trade with small amounts
entry_sequence.action: Trade the scalp with small size and focus on getting in and out quickly.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker frames scalping as a quick in-and-out trade.

entry_sequence.action: Enter when price comes down into support and bounces, then exit into the move at resistance.
entry_sequence.rationale: The trade is a support-to-resistance scalp.

targets.rationale: The speaker says to sell right at resistance.
